instructions: Moi file firmware co product, bootloaderSHA256 va build vid rieng. App doc /json/info.product de chon firmware, so khop bootloaderSHA256, sau do moi compare vid cua file da match. Thay url, size va sha256 bang file bin that truoc khi upload len server.

latest.notes: Build 2611230 cho ESP32-S3 N8R8. Co 3 file rieng cho HW board ARGB HSL Controller 4X, ARGB HSL Controller 2X Pro va ARGB HSL Controller 16X.

files.notes: Build 2611230 cho ARGB HSL Controller 4X: Sua loi mach tu khoi dong lai (bao loi 90) sau vai gio hoat dong: bo nho bi hao dan moi khi app hoac trinh duyet ngat ket noi dot ngot. Mach chay on dinh lau dai, khong con tu khoi dong lai.

Build 2611230 cho ARGB HSL Controller 2X Pro: Sua loi mach tu khoi dong lai (bao loi 90) sau vai gio hoat dong: bo nho bi hao dan moi khi app hoac trinh duyet ngat ket noi dot ngot. Mach chay on dinh lau dai, khong con tu khoi dong lai. POI HSL Studio can build 2611050 tro len.

Build 2611230 cho ARGB HSL Controller 16X: Sua loi mach tu khoi dong lai (bao loi 90) sau vai gio hoat dong: bo nho bi hao dan moi khi app hoac trinh duyet ngat ket noi dot ngot. Mach chay on dinh lau dai, khong con tu khoi dong lai.

Build 2611231 cho ARGB HSL Controller Lucky (ESP32-WROVER): Vong quay may man v1.0.0: cac mach xep vong tron sang lan luot vai vong roi dung o mot mach ngau nhien, dong bo qua ESP-NOW. Luc cho quay cac mach chay mau ngau nhien nhe nhang. Nhan Quay tren web UI (Cong cu > Vong quay), Tool hoac app.

Build 2611232 cho ARGB HSL Controller Lucky (ESP32-S3 N16R8): Mach Lucky chinh thuc ESP32-S3 N16R8: 25 LED 5x5, 2 nut bam, loa. Nut A: bam = Quay, giu = Dat lai. Nut B: bam = Tat/Bat den, giu = Diem danh. Trang Vong quay co danh sach mach kem % song, luu thong so cho ca vong, nut tat den; am thanh khi den chay qua va khi trung so. Mach mat nguon hoac mat ket noi giua luc quay khong lam lech ket qua cua cac mach khac. Sua loi treo khi gui ESP-NOW va loi hong danh sach preset.
